methods.bootstrap: 4000 paired-seed cluster resamples; both roles kept together
methods.tactics: 400 own wins and 400 unique forced blocks, balanced by actor, four directions, line length 5..9; independently seeded positions
methods.historical: Last losing move before the final winning move, with exactly one opponent instant win and no own instant win; seen training positions
methods.trainingProbe: 24 independent in-memory copies; each receives one additional historical losing episode via the unmodified learner; discarded afterwards
caveats: Custom fixed bots are not optimal play
No evaluation boards are trained into the original model
Historical positions are not a held-out measure
A different bad move does not count as a corrected error
